question: For posts that contain 'data' in their title, identify users who have made comments with a score greater than 5 on these posts. Among these users, find the earlist one who have obtained at least one badge and have made more than 3 comments. For the qualifying user, calculate their total comment count and identify their most recent badge name. List their display names, most recent badge names, badge dates, and total comment counts.

prediction.sql:
WITH data_posts AS (
    SELECT "XCL_026" AS post_id
    FROM posts
    WHERE "XCL_035" LIKE '%data%'
),
qualifying_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_010" AS user_id
    FROM comments c
    JOIN data_posts dp ON c."XCL_006" = dp.post_id
    WHERE c."XCL_007" > 5
),
user_comment_counts AS (
    SELECT "XCL_010" AS user_id, COUNT("XCL_005") AS total_comments
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY "XCL_010"
    HAVING COUNT("XCL_005") > 3
),
user_badge_info AS (
    SELECT b."XCL_002" AS user_id, MIN(b."XCL_004") AS earliest_badge_date
    FROM badges b
    JOIN qualifying_users qu ON b."XCL_002" = qu.user_id
    GROUP BY b."XCL_002"
),
final_candidates AS (
    SELECT ubi.user_id, ubi.earliest_badge_date
    FROM user_badge_info ubi
    JOIN user_comment_counts ucc ON ubi.user_id = ucc.user_id
),
selected_user AS (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM final_candidates
    ORDER BY earliest_badge_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
most_recent_badge AS (
    SELECT b."XCL_003" AS badge_name, b."XCL_004" AS badge_date
    FROM badges b
    WHERE b."XCL_002" = (SELECT user_id FROM selected_user)
    ORDER BY b."XCL_004" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
    mrb.badge_name,
    mrb.badge_date,
    ucc.total_comments
FROM selected_user su
JOIN users u ON su.user_id = u."XCL_052"
JOIN user_comment_counts ucc ON su.user_id = ucc.user_id
CROSS JOIN most_recent_badge mrb

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH data_posts AS (
    SELECT "XCL_026" AS post_id
    FROM posts
    WHERE "XCL_035" LIKE '%data%'
),
qualifying_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_010" AS user_id
    FROM comments c
    JOIN data_posts dp ON c."XCL_006" = dp.post_id
    WHERE c."XCL_007" > 5
),
user_comment_counts AS (
    SELECT "XCL_010" AS user_id, COUNT("XCL_005") AS total_comments
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY "XCL_010"
    HAVING COUNT("XCL_005") > 3
),
user_badge_info AS (
    SELECT b."XCL_002" AS user_id, MIN(b."XCL_004") AS earliest_badge_date
    FROM badges b
    JOIN qualifying_users qu ON b."XCL_002" = qu.user_id
    GROUP BY b."XCL_002"
),
final_candidates AS (
    SELECT ubi.user_id, ubi.earliest_badge_date
    FROM user_badge_info ubi
    JOIN user_comment_counts ucc ON ubi.user_id = ucc.user_id
),
selected_user AS (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM final_candidates
    ORDER BY earliest_badge_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
most_recent_badge AS (
    SELECT b."XCL_003" AS badge_name, b."XCL_004" AS badge_date
    FROM badges b
    WHERE b."XCL_002" = (SELECT user_id FROM selected_user)
    ORDER BY b."XCL_004" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
    mrb.badge_name,
    mrb.badge_date,
    ucc.total_comments
FROM selected_user su
JOIN users u ON su.user_id = u."XCL_052"
JOIN user_comment_counts ucc ON su.user_id = ucc.user_id
CROSS JOIN most_recent_badge mrb

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH qualifying_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_010 AS user_id
    FROM posts p
    JOIN comments c ON p.XCL_026 = c.XCL_006
    WHERE p.XCL_035 LIKE '%data%'
      AND c.XCL_007 > 5
),
user_badge_counts AS (
    SELECT q.user_id, MIN(b.XCL_004) AS earliest_badge_date
    FROM qualifying_users q
    JOIN badges b ON q.user_id = b.XCL_002
    GROUP BY q.user_id
    HAVING COUNT(b.XCL_001) >= 1
),
user_comment_counts AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_010 AS user_id, COUNT(c.XCL_005) AS total_comments
    FROM comments c
    GROUP BY c.XCL_010
    HAVING COUNT(c.XCL_005) > 3
),
final_candidates AS (
    SELECT ubc.user_id, ubc.earliest_badge_date
    FROM user_badge_counts ubc
    JOIN user_comment_counts ucc ON ubc.user_id = ucc.user_id
)
SELECT 
    u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
    b.XCL_003 AS most_recent_badge_name,
    b.XCL_004 AS badge_date,
    ucc.total_comments
FROM final_candidates fc
JOIN users u ON fc.user_id = u.XCL_052
JOIN user_comment_counts ucc ON fc.user_id = ucc.user_id
JOIN badges b ON fc.user_id = b.XCL_002
WHERE b.XCL_004 = (
    SELECT MAX(b2.XCL_004) 
    FROM badges b2 
    WHERE b2.XCL_002 = fc.user_id
)
ORDER BY fc.earliest_badge_date ASC
LIMIT 1

    JOIN user_comment_counts ucc ON ubi.user_id = ucc.user_id
),
selected_user AS (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM final_candidates
    ORDER BY earliest_badge_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
most_recent_badge AS (
    SELECT b."XCL_003" AS badge_name, b."XCL_004" AS badge_date
    FROM badges b
    WHERE b."XCL_002" = (SELECT user_id FROM selected_user)
    ORDER BY b."XCL_004" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
    mrb.badge_name,
    mrb.badge_date,
    ucc.total_comments
FROM selected_user su
JOIN users u ON su.user_id = u."XCL_052"
JOIN user_comment_counts ucc ON su.user_id = ucc.user_id
CROSS JOIN most_recent_badge mrb
